cover_letter_text:
Hi Cardinia Shire Council team,

I'm Marc, and I'm after a graduate engineering role. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I graduated with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your new Development Engineer role is open to recent graduates and values an understanding of drainage principles, so I'm applying.

In the course I designed stormwater drainage, roads and earthworks in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. On site in the Philippines, from April 2019 to February 2020, I reviewed drawings, did quality checks and wrote the site and progress reports.

I'm based in Melton with my own car and a full Victorian driver's licence. I can start two weeks after an offer and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
